catch: Apache-2.0. Mixture-of-experts: 35B parameters, 3B active per token. Text and image input through the pinned F16 vision projector.
notes: Unsloth Dynamic IQ4_NL_XL imatrix GGUF of Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, with the F16 vision projector from the same repository. GGUF header: architecture qwen35moe (linear-attention layers with full attention every 4th layer), 40 layers, 256 experts with 8 routed experts per token plus a shared expert, 262,144-token training context. Projector header: clip vision encoder (27 blocks, 16-pixel patches, 768-pixel input, qwen3vl_merger projector). Embedded tokenizer and chat template with tool-call and thinking markup. The upstream card also lists video input, which this entry does not declare.
